newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close down at end of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close down at end of settlement.

text.p: Delhi shares closed lower in hectic trade on Friday, the end of settlement, as profit-taking by speculators more than offset selective buying by foreign investors, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 5.13 points down at 804.35.
"Today's reaction towards the market was expected by all major players in view of the settlement end," said Vijay Agarwal of brokers Mass Financial Services.
Reliance Industies ended 5.45 rupees down at 305.50.
ACC shed 57.25 rupees to close at 1,111.
ITC ended five rupees down at 483.
